policy: Reuse recorded competitor timings by default; benchmark changed builder paths only.
qualified_results: pairs[].current[].methods.NativeSingle and NativeParallel, with report paths in each row's evidence
comparison: Identify saved-baseline comparisons explicitly. Preserve dates, confidence intervals and report provenance. Do not present them as same-run comparisons.
missing_or_incompatible: Record the gap; do not silently rerun competitors or claim a qualified win. Establish a new baseline only when required by the agreed scope.
builder_only_results: pairs[].builder_only; excluded from measured_current_apis until a compatible comparison is available
